question: According to the Indian Bureau of mines 2020, which two states of India have the maximum gold ore reserves?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar and Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gold **in its purest form is a ***bright, slightly reddish yellow, dense, soft malleable, and ductile metal***.
 
• It is one of the **least reactive chemical elements **and is solid *under standard conditions*.
 
• **Gold **often occurs in **free elemental (native) **form, as *nuggets or grains, in rocks, in veins, and alluvial deposits*.
 
• **Gold dissolves **in an **alkaline solution of cyanide**, which is used in mining and electroplating.
 
• **Gold** is **resistant **to **corrosion **and to **most acids **and has unique properties distinct from other metals.
 
• By States, the largest resources in terms of gold ore (primary) are located in **Bihar (44%)** followed by **Rajasthan (25%), Karnataka (21%), West Bengal &

 Andhra Pradesh (3% each)** and **Jharkhand (2%).**
 
• The remaining **2%** resources of ore are located in ***Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Kerala, Maharashtra

 , and Tamil Nadu.***
 
• Although, **Bihar **is the **leading State in India **as far as resources of **gold ore **are concerned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**Indian Bureau of Mines:**__

 
• The Indian Bureau of Mines was set up on **1st March 1948**.
 
• Initially **IBM **functioned **purely** as an **advisory body**.
 
• It helped the government in framing various rules like **Mines & Minerals (Regulation & Development) Act, 1948, Mineral Concession Rules, 1949, and Petroleum Concession Rules, 1949**.
 
• **IBM **was given a set of functions in **1950 **and by it, the inspection of mines and mineral prospects became a regular activity.
 
• By **1953 IBM **was given an additional function of undertaking detailed exploration of mineral deposits.
 
• Among the minerals explored by **IBM **were ***Iron Ore, Limestone, Dolomite, Coal, Copper, and Tungsten.***
 
• Later **Mineral Conservation & Development Rules,1955, and Mining Leases (Modification of Terms),1956 **were framed.
 
• An **ore dressing laboratory **was set up in **Delhi **in **1955**.
